premises.text: There is a labor crisis in the US across multiple industries having a $1 trillion negative impact on the US economy

premises.text: Robotic innovation has focused on factory automation that doesn't translate well to everyday automation

premises.text: Current industrial robots are limited by expensive and complex components
premises.evidence_span: These industrial robots have big external control boxes with difficult-to-manufacture strainwave gears and legacy PLCs, limiting where robots need to go in the future

premises.text: The Ally arm can significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation
premises.evidence_span: we can significantly expand the market for robotic technology and everyday automation

premises.text: Proven planetary gears are more efficient and cost-effective than strainwave gears

premises.text: The Ally arm is designed to be easy to service and program
premises.evidence_span: Now, anyone will be able to service the robot, just like replacing the batteries in your flashlight

premises.text: The Ally arm can be programmed by demonstrating tasks to it
premises.evidence_span: even my five-year-old will be able to program the robot by showing it, and the robot will then repeat that task
